statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are ICD-10 I48.0 and I48.91
The procedure code billed is CPT 93247
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service was rejected because the procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to optimize rate control and assess for further arrhythmic burden
